appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Adjust theme, density, language and accent color

ai.title: AI model
ai.subtitle: Provider and model for import analysis, automatic categorisation and insights
ai.providerNoneHint: Without a provider Budget-Pal uses only rules, fuzzy matching and local embeddings — the AI stage is skipped.
ai.apiKeySaved: Saved — leave empty to keep it
ai.contextUnknown: Context window unknown — a conservative default applies. Move the slider right if your model can take more; set too high, the server will reject the request.
ai.legend: ✓ connection tested · 🔑 API key stored — settings are kept per provider
ai.endpointHintLocal: localhost is rewritten to host.docker.internal inside the container
ai.endpointHintCloud: Provider default — only change it when going through a proxy or another region
ai.kimiCodeNote: Kimi says the Kimi Code subscription is meant for coding tools. For your own applications Kimi recommends the Kimi Platform (API, pay-as-you-go).
ai.keyRetype: New endpoint — please enter the API key again. A stored key is only ever sent to the endpoint it was saved with.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Session duration and passwordless sign-in
security.sessionDurationHint: How long a sign-in stays valid — applies from the next sign-in; an already issued token keeps its expiry.
security.passkeysHint: Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello or a security key — sign in without a password. Adding one needs your current password; you will get an info email.
security.passkeyFailed: Could not register the passkey. Passkeys require HTTPS or localhost.
security.passkeyUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
security.passwordHint: After changing it, all other devices are signed out. This session stays active.
security.passwordDone: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
security.passwordMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
security.passwordTooShort: The new password needs at least 8 characters.
security.passwordTooMany: Too many attempts — please try again in a few minutes.

backup.title: Backup
backup.keysWarn: The file contains your API keys in plain text. Keep it safe and do not share it.
backup.passwordHint: The keys are only released with your password — a signed-in browser alone is not enough.
backup.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts — please try again in a few minutes.
backup.optSettings: Restore settings & API keys (overwrites language, session length and AI provider)
backup.importError: Import failed. Please check the backup file.
